excerpt.zh:
[From.GetName]上的气体开采设施已经化为一片火海。据报道，那种高度易燃的气体遇到了明火，导致了许多设施的爆炸！经过一连串的连锁反应，几乎炸光了我们侦探到的所有气体矿藏。

不能再犯同样的错误了。

texts.zh:
[From.GetName]上的气体开采设施已经化为一片火海。据报道，那种高度易燃的气体遇到了明火，导致了许多设施的爆炸！经过一连串的连锁反应，几乎炸光了我们侦探到的所有气体矿藏。

不能再犯同样的错误了。
texts.en:
The gas mining facility on [From.GetName] has turned into a burning inferno. The report says that the highly volatile gas was exposed an open flame, causing multiple facilities to explode! This in turn caused a chain reaction and blew up most of the gas caches we had located.

This backlash cannot be allowed to be repeated.

texts.zh:
[From.GetName]上的气体开采设施已经化为一片火海。据报道，那种高度易燃的气体遇到了明火，导致了许多设施的爆炸！经过一连串的连锁反应，几乎炸光了我们侦探到的所有气体矿藏。

我们会缅怀在爆炸中死去的同胞。
texts.en:
The gas mining facility on [From.GetName] has turned into a burning inferno. The report says that the highly volatile gas was exposed an open flame, causing multiple facilities to explode! This in turn caused a chain reaction and blew up most of the gas caches we had located.

The people who died in the explosion won't be forgotten.

texts.zh: 富含能源的气体已经耗尽。这个殖民地已失去额外的资源输出，大大增加了我们对新矿藏的需求。
texts.en: The energy rich gas found on one of our colonies has now depleted. The extra resource output has been lost, greatly increasing our need for new deposits to replace it.

texts.zh: 我们占据的殖民地曾拥有丰富的地下气体资源。但现在已经耗尽，工厂的能源输出降低。
texts.en: The colony we took over used to hold rich resources of gas underneath the surface. Now they've depleted, reducing the energy output of our industries.

summary.text:
# 失败 / Failure

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration (C3)
- 来源 Sources：`events/anomaly_events_3.txt:5114-5160` · `events/failures.txt:490`
- 审阅 Review：2026-10-13（c3b-exploration）· 已审阅 Reviewed

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 带gas_rich_planet修正的星球被殖民时(on_colonized)隐藏事件4171触发，且殖民者须持有旗标limited_modifier_gas_rich_planet（common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1297）。  
  Hidden event 4171 fires when a planet with the gas_rich_planet modifier is colonised (on_colonized), and the owner must have limited_modifier_gas_rich_planet (common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1297).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 4171移除修正，换成720天的gas_rich_planet_fo_realz，然后30%：360天后anomaly_failure.4170“煤气设施燃爆”；70%：720天后4172“挥发资源耗尽”（清除旗标）。  
  4171 removes the modifier and adds a 720-day gas_rich_planet_fo_realz, then 30%: anomaly_failure.4170 (gas facility inferno) after 360 days; 70%: 4172 (volatile resources depleted) after 720 days (flag cleared).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 4170与4172互斥（30/70）。  
  4170 and 4172 are exclusive (30/70).

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 描述随是否平等主义者/是否征服者变化。  
  Text varies with egalitarianism and whether the owner is the original colonist.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已对照原文。  
  Compared the originals.
